scripts.build: pnpm run clean:dist && pnpm run tokens:build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node ./scripts/copy_static.mjs
scripts.dev: pnpm run clean:dist && pnpm run tokens:build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node ./scripts/copy_static.mjs && concurrently "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch" "tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --watch" "pnpm run copy:watch" "node ./scripts/start_electron_hot.mjs"
scripts.test:node: node --test tests/schedule-preserve.test.mjs tests/load-state-recovery.test.mjs tests/init-startup-autoplan.test.mjs tests/state-store-json-atomic.test.mjs tests/state-store-sqlite.test.mjs tests/state-store-migration.test.mjs tests/state-recover.test.mjs
